overview_description.description: Terminal provides telematics data infrastructure for the commercial fleet industry. The platform connects software companies, insurers, fleet operators, and other businesses with vehicle data from multiple telematics providers through a unified integration layer. It manages data ingestion, provider integrations, consent workflows, and data delivery to support fleet management, insurance, fuel services, and transportation applications.

about_short_description.short_description: Terminal provides telematics data infrastructure that connects commercial fleet platforms with vehicle data from multiple providers.

product.name: Terminal Telematics Data Infrastructure Platform
product.description: An API-driven platform that connects commercial fleet products to telematics data from hundreds of providers, normalizing and delivering real-time, historical, raw, and canonical data through APIs, webhooks, and bulk delivery.

product.name: Terminal for Insurance
product.description: Telematics data infrastructure for commercial auto insurers, supporting data-driven underwriting, pricing, risk scoring, loss control, and claims workflows using historical and ongoing fleet data.

product.name: Terminal for Fleet Management
product.description: Telematics data infrastructure for fleet management software, providing normalized vehicle location, status, diagnostics, fuel, engine, and trip data for visibility, maintenance, utilization, and automation workflows.

product.name: Terminal for Fuel Cards
product.description: Telematics data infrastructure for fuel card programs that validates vehicle and transaction details, detects fuel fraud, synchronizes fleet entities, and supports automated IFTA reporting.

product.name: Terminal for Transportation Management
product.description: Telematics data infrastructure for transportation and logistics software, providing real-time and historical location, hours-of-service, trailer, and trip data for dispatch, tracking, routing, verification, and claims workflows.

identifier.value: Telematics Provider Integration and Partner Service

product.name: Telematics Provider Integration and Partner Service
product.description: A managed integration service that connects telematics providers with commercial fleet platforms, handling integration development, data mapping, testing, monitoring, maintenance, and support while preserving partner data ownership and relationships.
